messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Stimulants have caused stroke, heart attack, and sudden death in people with high blood pressure, heart disease, or a heart defect.
Your healthcare provider should check you or your child carefully for heart problems before starting Adderall.
Your healthcare provider should check blood pressure and heart rate regularly during treatment.
Call your healthcare provider right away or go to the nearest hospital emergency room if you or your child have any signs of heart problems.
These signs include chest pain, shortness of breath, or fainting during treatment.
Mental (psychiatric) problems:
Adderall may cause new or worse behavior and thought problems.
Adderall may cause new or worse bipolar illness.
Adderall may cause new psychotic symptoms, such as hearing voices, or seeing or believing things that are not real.
Adderall may cause new manic symptoms.
This is more likely if you have a history of depression, mental illness, or bipolar disorder.

The relation 'should check for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is required to monitor or assess the object entity prior to initiating treatment.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'used in combination with': The subject drug is used together with the other treatment or lifestyle measure specified by the object entity.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
